RAVIKANTH PENDYALA

Pricing & Billing| Project Manager

Platforms: VisionPLUS | TSYS Prime & TS2 | HPS PowerCARD | GBS / ORMB

9494061219 | ravikanth.pendyala@gmail.com | PRINCE2 Practitioner | PSM I | ITIL Foundation

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Accomplished  Project  Manager,  Business  Analyst,  and  Test  Lead  with  over  15+  years  of

extensive experience  delivering  large-scale  transformation,  core  platform  migration,  and

regulatory programs  across  the  Cards  &  Payments  domain.  Proven  track  record  managing

end-to-end project  lifecycles,  Agile/Scrum  and  Waterfall  deliveries,  requirements  elicitation

(BRD/FRD),  business  process  re-engineering,  scheme  compliance  (Visa/Mastercard/3DS),

and  enterprise  SIT/UAT  execution.  Expert

in  bridging  business  strategy  with  technical

delivery,  stakeholder  governance,  RAID  management,  vendor  coordination,  and  zero-defect

production rollouts.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Project  &  Delivery  Management:  Agile

& Capacity Management

Readiness & Cutover Execution

Business Analysis:

-Is  /  To-

Cards & Payments Domain:

Quality  &  Test  Leadership:

Recovery (DR) Drills

1 | P a g e

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

CSI Global  Senior Business Analyst, HSBC APAC | Feb 2025  Present

Role Focus: Business Analysis & Solutions Engineering

Partner with global product owners and technology teams for the HSBC Malaysia

Billing & Pricing (DNAD) program to deliver pricing models and settlement

frameworks.

Review Incoming Request (IR) documentation, facilitate elicitation sessions, and

conduct comprehensive upstream/downstream impact analysis.

Configure, define, and maintain Rate Cards, automated pricing rules, and billing

workflows in alignment with enterprise architecture.

Author functional specifications (FRD) and lead Malaysian 3DS In-App security

implementation, coordinating scheme certification and compliance with

Visa/Mastercard mandates.

Bridge business and QA teams by defining E2E test scenarios, driving defect triage,

and managing production readiness governance.

Optimum Info Systems  Business Analyst, DBS | Mar 2023  Aug 2024

Role Focus: Agile Business Analysis & Migration Delivery

Functioned as core Business Analyst for the strategic core platform migration from

VisionPLUS to HPS PowerCARD across Credit, Debit, and Prepaid card portfolios.

Collaborated with Product Owners and Solution Architects to refine user stories,

establish acceptance criteria, and prioritize sprint backlogs.

Facilitated sprint ceremonies, monitored sprint velocity and burndown metrics, and

resolved blockers across multi-functional delivery teams.

Coordinated SIT, UAT, and scheme certification test suites to validate requirement

traceability and mitigate functional drift before cutover.

Partnered with release and operations teams to establish cutover checkpoints and

post-go-live stabilization.

Go Live Faster / Zentest

Project Manager & QA Lead, UMB Kansas | Dec 2021  Feb

2023

Role Focus: Project Management & QA Leadership

Commanded a 26-member cross-functional project and testing team across DEV

validation, System Integration Testing (SIT), and Options Testing streams.

Directed the end-to-end migration lifecycle from Fiserv to TSYS TS2, delivering the

program on schedule with zero business disruption.

2 | P a g e

Managed cross-border stakeholder alignment, capacity planning, daily status

reporting, and onshore/offshore resource optimization.

Formulated the cutover readiness strategy, overseeing go-live runbooks, weekend

migration execution, and production smoke tests.

SRIT  Project Manager, ICICI Bank | Jan 2021  Nov 2021

Role Focus: Project Delivery & Platform Operations

Managed project delivery, change initiatives, and BAU support releases for the

enterprise TSYS Prime Cards ecosystem.

Controlled scope, release schedules, and risk logs for regular release cycles and

complex change requests (CRs).

Led weekly stakeholder governance forums, reporting on project progress, defect

aging, service level agreements (SLAs), and risk mitigation plans.

Coordinated middleware, card management, and core banking teams to align

integration dependencies, conduct DR drills, and secure release approvals.

ValueLabs  Project Manager, ADIB UAE | Dec 2018  Dec 2020

Role Focus: Project Management & Channel Solutions

Managed  cross-channel  delivery  projects  encompassing  ATM  (NCR),  TCR

(Diebold), Ambit Teller, and Credit Card integration enhancements.

Supervised  end-to-end  project  roadmaps,  vendor  contracts,  and  resource

allocations while managing stakeholder expectations across business and IT units.

Evaluated ITSM change requests, tracked critical path milestones, and conducted

RAID reviews to maintain timeline adherence.

Spearheaded  user  acceptance  testing  governance  and  sign-off  processes  for

critical banking channel releases.

Verinite

Project Manager | Nov 2017  Nov 2018

Role Focus: Project Delivery & Cards Consulting

Directed  client  engagements  and  program  workstreams  for  Cards  &  Payments

transformation and platform upgrade initiatives.

Structured  project  charters,  defined  resource  allocation  matrices,  and  tracked

deliverables against agreed SLAs.

Orchestrated  collaboration  between  business  teams  and  technical  vendors  to

ensure solution designs satisfied regulatory and card scheme standards.

Managed delivery risks, scope changes, and executive steering committee status

presentations.

3 | P a g e

Cognizant

Senior Test Lead | Sep 2009   Nov 2017

Role Focus: Test Leadership & Quality Governance

Led comprehensive QA programs for Cards & Payments transformation programs,

including major TSYS Prime to VisionPLUS card migrations.

Formulated Master Test Plans, test estimation models, and execution frameworks

for Credit Card migration, regulatory mandates, and BAU projects.

Facilitated  requirement  walkthroughs,  managed  requirement  traceability

matrices (RTM), and coordinated Visa/Mastercard certification mandates.

Oversaw  defect  management  life  cycles,  defect  triage  meetings,  and  provided

daily executive QA dashboard metrics across onshore/offshore models.

Capgemini   Senior Test Lead | Mar 2006   Sep 2009

Role Focus: Test Lead & System Validation

Managed  end-to-end  SIT  and  UAT  delivery  cycles  for  core  TSYS  Prime

implementations and version upgrades.

Established  daily  defect  tracking,  status  reporting,  and  resource  management

across the hybrid onshore-offshore model.

Validated batch processing, transaction authorizations, and clearing/settlement

test scenarios.
